no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not referred for an Advisory Committee meeting as no clinical efficacy or safety issues arose that required an Advisory Committee meeting and discussion.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for Venclexta (venetoclax) NDA208573. The Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, Office Director memo, and Medical Review all state the application was not referred to an (Oncology Drugs) Advisory Committee because no clinical efficacy or safety issues required discussion and the Division was familiar with the trial design and endpoints, with review conducted on an expedited timeline under Breakthrough Therapy designation. Because no committee met, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to changes in the approval.
